# Backend Interview Questions 2026

> A free, open-source reference of 337 backend engineering interview questions and answers,
> covering Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, DBMS, Design Patterns, and Microservices.

Each topic page explains how the underlying technology actually works — not just vocabulary —
paired with a diagram, a realistic Java/Spring Boot code example, and an "Interview Questions"
callout. A separate Question Bank page per topic pairs every question on the site with a
condensed answer, grouped by subtopic, for fast self-testing without re-reading the prose. Aimed
at backend developers with roughly 0-2 years of experience, but useful as a refresher for anyone.

## Topics

- [Kafka](https://alitalhacoban.github.io/backend-interview-questions-2026/docs/category/kafka): architecture, producer internals, consumer groups and rebalancing, delivery semantics, replication and ISR, the outbox/inbox pattern, common production pitfalls (44 questions)
- [Java Core](https://alitalhacoban.github.io/backend-interview-questions-2026/docs/category/java-core): OOP fundamentals, JVM and memory model, collections framework, exception handling, concurrency, generics and type erasure, streams and functional interfaces, string/object contracts (50 questions)
- [Spring Boot](https://alitalhacoban.github.io/backend-interview-questions-2026/docs/category/spring-boot): Spring and Spring Boot fundamentals, IoC and dependency injection, auto-configuration and starters, Spring MVC and REST, Spring Data JPA and transactions, AOP and proxies, Spring Security, testing, configuration/Actuator, design patterns in Spring's own APIs (61 questions)
- [DBMS](https://alitalhacoban.github.io/backend-interview-questions-2026/docs/category/dbms): relational theory, keys and SQL, normalization, indexing, transactions and ACID, concurrency control and isolation levels, query optimization, storage and recovery, replication/sharding/NoSQL (59 questions)
- [Design Patterns](https://alitalhacoban.github.io/backend-interview-questions-2026/docs/category/design-patterns): GoF creational, structural, and behavioral patterns, Singleton and thread safety, dependency injection and enterprise patterns, concurrency patterns, anti-patterns/pattern selection (64 questions)
- [Microservices](https://alitalhacoban.github.io/backend-interview-questions-2026/docs/category/microservices): microservices fundamentals, service communication, API gateways and service discovery, data management and distributed transactions, resilience patterns, observability, deployment and orchestration, security, anti-patterns/trade-offs (59 questions)
